name: ABEFA
description: A comprehensive university freshman learning platform designed to help Ethiopian university students succeed in their first year. It features detailed subject master notes, digital textbooks, study guides, practice questions, mock exams, formula cheat sheets, AI-powered tutoring, exam preparation tools, and personalized learning resources. The platform also includes student authentication, educational resource management, Telebirr payment verification for premium content, and an AI exam generator to support independent learning and academic success.
